title: Matsumoto Castle — Matsumoto City Official Tourism Website

facts.fact: The castle is designated a National Treasure and has five external stories and six internal floors.
facts.excerpt: oldest extant keep with five external stories but six internal floors.

facts.fact: The moon-viewing tower was added in an era of peace, contrasting with the wartime keep.
facts.excerpt: Tsukimi Yagura (moon-viewing tower), which was added in an era of peace.

facts.fact: The municipal visitor address places the castle in Marunouchi, Matsumoto, Nagano.

notes: Official page actually fetched and the named passages read; raw response and extracted text retained outside Git. Route choices and priorities are original editorial advice. No personal visit, demand ranking, guaranteed mountain view, price or timetable is claimed.
